"''Princess Leia? See-Threepio?|Wicket and Pommet Warrick, upon witnessing the destruction of a Star Destroyer|}} '''Pommet Warrick''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Ewok]] who lived on the [[Endor|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)|Endor]] during the time of the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. Being the son of [[Wicket Wystri Warrick|Wicket W. Warrick]], he grew up hearing the tales of how the Ewoks of the [[Bright Tree Village]] and the heroes of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] had joined forces to [[Battle of Endor|defeat]] the mighty [[Galactic Empire]] in the [[Standard year|year]] [[4 ABY]].''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' The young Wokling grew up in his father's shadow and he craved seeing [[Planet|worlds]] beyond his [[moon]]. In [[35 ABY]], when a [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] appeared in the atmosphere above Endor, he became distraught. Following the [[Battle of Exegol]], the [[Star Destroyer]] stationed above Endor was [[Uprising on Endor|destroyed]] by a [[Unidentified heavy freighter|heavy freighter]] through use of the [[Holdo maneuver]].{{Film|IX}} From the surface of the Forest Moon, Pommet and his father witnessed the fall of the Destroyer, and they evoked the memory of the battle that had taken place thirty-one years ago, with Pommet musing whether the late [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] or the [[droid]] [[C-3PO]] had destroyed the Destroyer. It was taken as a potential sign from the Ewoks' [[deity]], the [[Golden One]]. ==Behind the scenes== Pommet Warrick first appeared in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], the third and final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]]. He was not named in the film itself but received identification in its credits. He was portrayed by [[Harrison Davis]], the real-life son of Wicket's actor [[Warwick Davis]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2019/12/star-wars-the-rise-of-skywalker-cameos-who-were-the-jedi-voices-jodie-comer-reys-mom/amp|text=25 ''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Cameos You Might Have Missed|author=Anthony Breznican, Joanna Robinson|date=2019-12-19|quote=Even more fun, the Ewok we know has a young Ewok beside him — his son, Pommet.
